record.name: AF-controlled ClinVar >=2-star missense SNVs held out from Dec 2023 (gnomAD grpmax < 0.1%, 8,141 variants)
record.description: 8,141 ClinVar 2026-11-08 >=2-star clean missense SNVs held out from 2023-12-26 restricted to gnomAD v3.1.2 non-1000G genome grpmax < 0.1% (5,454 P/LP, 2,687 B/LB).

attributes.protocol: Temporal holdout from clinvar_20231226.vcf.gz filtered to gnomAD v3.1.2 genome grpmax < 0.001 following rewire-benchmarks #53 and #54, calibrated against 6,312 population missense SNVs (gft = 0.03). Calibrated with alpha = 0.0441, c = 1124, minpoints = 100 and 1,000-bootstrap one-sided 95% conservative bounds (seed 20261123).

uncertainty_reporting.definition: One-sided 95% conservative bootstrap discounted thresholds (Bergquist et al. 2025) and two-sided 95% percentile intervals for AUROC/AUPRC.

limitations: Controls common-benign AF inflation; AlphaGenome AVI loses PP3 Strong (+4) and AlphaMissense loses BP4 tiers under this filter.
Precomputed score tables on temporally held-out ClinVar >=2-star missense SNVs; does not evaluate indels, noncoding variants or predictors absent from public lookup tables.
EVEE (Zenodo 19701997) incorporates ClinVar supervision through 2026-03-20 and has direct target exposure on post_2023_12 and post_2025_03; withheld as a leaked descriptive control.

run_recipes.title: ClinGen PP3/BP4 missense calibration on post_2023_12_af001
run_recipes.summary: Calibrate precomputed missense predictor scores on the AF-controlled ClinVar post_2023_12_af001 holdout (5,454 P/LP, 2,687 B/LB) against 6,312 gnomAD reference missense SNVs using Pejaver 2022 and Bergquist 2025 local posterior odds.
inputs: Cohort TSV (post_2023_12_af001.tsv, 8,141 ClinVar >=2-star missense SNVs) and gnomAD v3.1.2 reference missense TSV (6,312 SNVs).
Eight precomputed score tables for GPN-MSA, GPN-Star-V, GPN-Star-M, AlphaGenome AVI, AVI PHRED, AlphaMissense, REVEL and CADD PHRED.
outputs: Per-predictor report.json with AUROC, AUPRC, 1,000-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals, one-sided 95% conservative PP3/BP4 score thresholds, reach shares and interval likelihood ratios.
Verified receipt.json and SHA256SUMS written locally; nothing is submitted automatically.

requirements.data: Pinned cohort, gnomAD reference and precomputed score tables from rewire-bio/rewire-benchmarks at fbf4fd5df880ee685fa276dfa6a5bb46da4bcf73 (SHA-256 verified during recipe fetch).
requirements.weights: No neural network weights; evaluates precomputed variant score lookup tables.
requirements.licence: Runner and recipe are MIT; check upstream terms for individual predictor score tables.
requirements.software: Python 3.11 or newer with released rewirebench 0.6.1 from PyPI.
requirements.hardware: CPU execution (measured 67.6 s wall time and 0.23 GB peak RSS on Apple M4 arm64 across all eight predictors).

instructions.title: Run the full eight-predictor calibration recipe with released rewirebench 0.6.1
instructions.code:
curl --fail --location --remote-name https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rewire-bio/rewire-benchmarks/08fb03f9a47b0b934e73743eea08ccd36a25f0a7/recipes/clingen-pp3-bp4/clingen-pp3-bp4-af001-calibration.yaml
echo "3a66001b46aa6dca971010821a91b33b1c279a35463c7fd869c546740b60d88a  clingen-pp3-bp4-af001-calibration.yaml" | shasum -a 256 --check
uvx --from "rewirebench==0.6.1" rewirebench recipe run clingen-pp3-bp4-af001-calibration.yaml --work-dir runs/clingen-af001
uvx --from "rewirebench==0.6.1" rewirebench receipt verify runs/clingen-af001/receipt --strict

validation_receipt.source_locator: receipt.json and per-predictor report.json files (38/38 metric and coverage checks passed across 8 predictors)

limitations: Rerun with the project's own calibration implementation and pinned lookup tables, not an independent reproduction by another group.
Rescores precomputed missense lookup tables rather than rerunning upstream sequence or structure model inference.
Excludes EVEE (Zenodo 19701997) due to ClinVar training overlap through 2026-03-20.
